en: A monochrome vintage postcard view over a wide river with a side‑wheel steamship in midstream. In the foreground are several large residential villas surrounded by trees on a slope. Across the river lies a town with industrial buildings and church towers, and behind it rolling hills with scattered houses and fields. The caption in red at the top reads "Meissen. Blick vom Bergschlösschen".
